review_description: Good quality gear, tidy and efficient installation.  Prior to deciding, we worked through several possible scenarios as our set-up was not straightforward.  Supplier worked with us to design and spec a system that worked.  It's only been 3 days, so I can't say much more.

I have written him a review. The difference being that talking to a technical person rather than a salesman help me to understand what we wanted to achieve, how we could achieve it and what would meet our needs.

A very prompt response after the quotes were requested, resulting in a panels and battery system that is already significantly reducing my power bill and carbon footprint.Neat and tidy installation which happened on time, and good follow-up.

The installation went great, professional and helpful all the working were explained. Connection to the grid was all done. All the lead-up work quotes and installation were professional and helpful also a very friendly team.
TruBlu (Billy) provided excellent pre & post sales support and his team did a speedy and excellent job. TruBlu did all I was expecting and that little bit extra... Excellent work.

Really good people to deal with, in depth explanation of all aspects of the process. Good follow-up on the different stages of the project. Billy and his team have done a fantastic job with the new system, very neat and tidy workmanship.Thanks to everyone involved.

Billy and his team at Tru Blu Solar were great. Billy spent time with us to clearly explain the system and how much power we would need. The proposal was clear and easy to understand.The installation was done over 2 days. They arrived on time and were very nice guys to deal with - polite and tidy.We had a small misunderstanding re the position of the conduit, but Billy stepped up and went beyond our expectations to deliver a great outcome. The system was set up and is working well at this stage, generating more than we expected.We can highly recommend Billy and his team at Tru Blu Solar.
Matched a quote from another company. Very attentive to detail. Great app to view daily solar output and costs in and out. All paperwork for my retailer to assist in meter upgrade.

We were put in touch with Tru Blu by Solar Quotes. Billy the owner is very efficient and did a great job for us. We live in a townhouse with a 'difficult' roof for Solar, but Billy was well up to the markHis team are excellent too and did a wonderful job, despite the worst weather of the year! Yes - tidy, polite and punctual. Thank you, all. It was a pleasure to deal with each of you.

I requested 3 quotes through Solarquotes, Billy the owner of Tru Blu Solar promptly came back to me asked heaps of questions about what I was looking for, and offered advice on what I needed but also what I didn't need. He put a detailed proposal together, answered all questions and we signed up, we moved into the house 21 Nov , Billy has the system installed by his team 22Nov, they arrived on time, did a super clean install, cleaned up after and spend time to show me everything about the system. Billy then came back 2 days later to check everything was good. I am super happy with the service and the product.

Tru Blu did a great job from start to finish installing our Solar. Their communication was excellent back and forth. Price was very good compared to others. Their installers were on time both days, which is rare for a lot of tradies!!Quality of workmanship, was first class.
Tru Blue were extremely Professional & explained the process with no hidden costs. Delivery was excellent. Would highly recommend Billy & the Team.
From my enquiry email to installation and the system all setup and producing power was pain free..the system is making great power and will save a lot of $$$

For anyone looking to install solar panels on their home I highly reccoment Tru Blu. I had the pleasure of working with Billy, the owner, and his team, and I was very impressed with their professionalism, knowledge, and responsiveness.Billy was incredibly responsive to my inquiries. He answered all of my questions in a timely manner, and he was always happy to go the extra mile to make sure I understood everything. After speaking to 3 other providers, it became clear that Billy was exceptionally knowledgeable about solar panels and the solar industry, and he was able to provide me with sound advice on the best system for my needs. He also personally came to our house late on a Friday to ensure he could get on the roof and give the best possible quote and advice to us.The Tru Blu Solar team was also very efficient and professional. They arrived on time for the installation, and they worked quickly and neatly with no fuss.I was also very impressed with the quality of the solar panels and the installation they offered at a highly competitive price point. Tru Blu Solar only uses the latest and best quality products, and they take great care to ensure that the installation is done correctly. All of the work was done in house by Tru Blu Solar employees. This ensured that the installation was done to a high standard and that there were no communication errors between different contractors. As a result we are already seeing performance way above projections.Finally, I was impressed with the fact that Tru Blu Solar factored both the aesthetic and performance of the solar set up into their design. They wanted to make sure that the panels were not only efficient, but that they also looked good on my roof.Overall, I had a very positive experience with Tru Blu Solar. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to install solar panels on their home.I would highly recommend Tru Blu Solar to anyone looking to install solar panels on their home. They are a professional, knowledgeable, and responsive company that will deliver a high quality installation.

Billy, the proprietor and installer at Tru Blu Solar Co is the most reliable and trustworthy Tradie I have had the pleasure of dealing with. From the first contact with Billy, I was given all the options for my installation and for the rest of my install I was kept well informed. The end result is a super neat and tidy installation with absolutely no mess left behind as you would often get with other Tradies. The system itself if performing well above my expectations.I would highly recommend Billy and his very polite and friendly crew from Tru Blu Solar Co.

Billy has been upfront with us during the entire quoting process giving us the pros and cons of all his offerings and designed the system to make sure it could manage a future EV charger and batteries.  My garage is on the opposite side of the house so he also made sure to install the proper size cabling required to get there.The installation was over 2 days and they did great work - there was an issue after installation but they came back after a few days to fix it.  They also helped with the organising our smart meter.We're headed into winter but I've experienced generation of 60kWh a few days already - it'll be interesting to see what my system can do in summer!  If you're on the central coast give Billy a call!

The original quote was done by phone and then Billy from TRU BLU came out and asked our power usage and bill and then suggested what size solar system we would require.The installation was done before time date allocated.  We were notified of the chaange of date before the installers came.the installers arrived on time and were very polite and did a fantastic job.  The work site was left how they found it.The customer service has been great as we have been kept acros all that has been going on.We have not been connected to the grid yet but have been provided with the paperwork for this to take place.  If we have any problems we are to contact Billy from TRU BLU SOLAR CO.

Tru Blu Solar Co installed a 6.68kw system and the process was smooth and efficient. Good communication, tidy, polite and the customer service was good. I have no concerns recommending the boys at Tru Blu. Happy customer.

I'm glad to say that I had a great experience with Tru Blu all the way through the entire process.Billy was the first of the 3 installers to call me after submitting my quote request the night before, we had a chat about my requirements and set up an appointment for an onsite inspection. Unfortunately due to illness I had to reschedule however Billy was able to work around me no problems, this was important as we had only recently purchased the house and were yet to move in, making any site visit a special trip for myself.During the proposal stage, Billy walked me through the various options available, but he also wasn't averse to tweaking the design based on my desire to squeeze in a few extra panels, and also the general aesthetics and placement of the equipment. This is something the others would not do, and it felt like they just wanted to offer me a cookie cutter design without tailoring the solution to me. During this time I had all kinds of questions about the proposal and there was nothing too technical or too silly for Billy to answer.After deciding to proceed Tru Blu they didn't keep me waiting long, only a week and a few days. The install took place over several days and went quite well. Since we were doing renovations there were other trades present and everyone was able to work happily alongside despite earthmoving equipment coming and going causing limited access to the electrical box. Aside from their work being very tidy and aesthetically pleasing, I'd specifically like to call out the Tru Blu install team for being the friendliest and most polite tradespeople I've ever met.The system has now been running for a few weeks and everything is working fine and performing as quoted. We are learning to love the delay timer feature of our clothes and dishwashers to enjoy free power during the day.All up I had a really positive experience with Tru Blu and it's hard to fault them on anything. I wish all the best to Billy and his team.
I am now friends with supplier . Happy to provide evidence from pics and diagnostics.
